summary: Completed testing of bug fixes for Programs feature. Both critical bugs FIXED: 1) Clicking on program from list no longer throws 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render' error 2) Loader component is properly integrated in both pages. All 10 backend API tests pass. Full e2e flow works: login → programs list → click program → detail page → back button → programs list.

VERIFIED: Loader component properly added to chat.tsx (lines 47-52) with data-testid='programs-loading'
VERIFIED: Loader component used in program-detail.tsx (line 45) when loading state is true
Minor note: Back button throws development-only warning 'GO_BACK was not handled' when navigating directly to detail page without history - this is expected Expo Router behavior
